description: Use after the slide's claim is settled, to inform the layout options in the text plan (see get_playbook). Searches the curated library of slide design DNA by what a slide must do. Returns up to k short summaries (id, slide type, score, purpose, why it works, the layout's component kinds, impact device if any, style, when to use it), at most one per deck; an impact filter returns few results. Call get_reference with an id for the full layout. Reference, never copy.

impact.description: Only impact slides of this kind: how reference decks repeat a slide for effect. Use it when the user wants to emphasize or land a key point: shade_ribbon (the previous slide dimmed, a ribbon stating the takeaway), spotlight (one part highlighted), build (revealed step by step), repeat (an earlier slide brought back as a recap). Few exist.

purpose.description: What the slide must achieve, in plain words.

slide_type.description: Archetype id (see the archetypes stage of get_playbook).

style.description: Only slides from decks with this overall look.

name: find_references
title: Find reference slides
